name: Midas Golden Touch 3
review:
The third Midas game, on a 3x5 grid with 15 lines and a bonus of free spins that can retrigger.

It's darker and riskier than the earlier games, with volatility stepped up to high. The core loop is still multiplier wilds and a respin-driven bonus. 15,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.16%, so the Reborn version of the original is better value if you just want the classic Midas feel.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
